title: Imperfectum (simple past)
summary: Imperfectum is formed by adding -te/-ten or -de/-den to the verb stem.
rules: Take the stem of the verb (infinitive minus -en).
If the stem ends in K, F, S, T, CH, P (SOFTKETCHUPX / 't kofschip): add -te (singular) or -ten (plural).
If the stem ends in V, change to F: verven → verfde / verfden. If it ends in Z, change to S: reizen → reisde / reisden.
Watch out for spelling: double-vowel stems may shorten when adding suffix; single-consonant stems may double in present but not past.

examples.nl: Mijn vader werkte gisterenavond tot laat.
examples.en: My father worked yesterday evening until late.

examples.nl: Mijn collega woonde / mijn collega's woonden.
examples.en: My colleague lived / my colleagues lived.

examples.nl: Mijn moeder belde / mijn ouders belden.
examples.en: My mother called / my parents called.

examples.nl: De schilder verfde / de schilders verfden.
examples.en: The painter painted / the painters painted.

examples.nl: De backpacker reisde / de backpackers reisden.
examples.en: The backpacker travelled / the backpackers travelled.
